discovery_notes: Follow-up 3 of B011 (final before backlog); 27 standard WebSearches, excluded domains blocked. Reused keys from 211/418/460; checked WDW 209/415/458: no wdw keys for WALL-E Emoji or Disney Treats, so both keyed under dlr as shared DLR/WDW products. No holds released: no new per-pin evidence for the six Ice Cream designs, Jack/WDW set links or Coco Miguel. New: WALL-E Emoji set (6 pins, 29.99, DLR 13 Feb 2018) with 2 per-pin MPC designs; Disney Treats OE 4-pin set (24.99, Sep 2018) with 4 designs held as single-list names; lanyard medal combo price 17.99.
